pages.title: Scintillator Crystal
pages.text: A crystal that flashes when a particle passes through it. Each flash is proportional to the energy deposited, so counting them tells me what was made in a collision. It is clear and slightly blue, and twinkles constantly from cosmic rays.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Lattice Growth Vat I grew Cherenkov Quartz with Quantum Dots in superfluid helium. Every passing particle lit a dot, and the flashes gave me a clear count of each collision.
Made in $(item)Lattice Growth Vat$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Calorimeter Detector Array.
